content: As ShapeWorldICE exploits a limited size of open-class words, we emphasize the diversity in ShapeWorldICE at the sentence level rather than the word level. Since the ground-truth reference captions in ShapeWorld are randomly sampled, we take the sampled captions accompanying the test images as a proxy for optimal caption diversity, and compare it with the empirical output diversity of the evaluated model on these test images. Practically, we look at language constructions used and compute the corresponding diversity score as the ratio of observed number versus optimal number:
